sources.observation: A long white weatherboard verandah extends beneath red gable roofs and the square bell-roofed tower. The upper balcony is open behind a pierced rail.
The coast-side view shows the tower crown, wraparound balcony and pale wood bracing. The main building and its lawn are separate from the roadside fence.

limitations: Tower height, roof pitches, white fretwork and local ground transitions are estimated from exterior photographs and map elevations. The model covers the main palace exterior.
